messages:
Luis Romero: Quick sync 1: prepping the launch post + webinar hook for next Tues. Need final battlecard bullets and SDR call scripts by EOD. Short timeline.
Luis Romero: Link to draft assets: <https://drive.redwood/launch-assets|launch-assets> 
Maya Chen: On it. Can someone paste the latest benchmark TL;DR? want a one-sentence stat for the hero.
bench-bot-2: nightly-bench: 2025-06-02 04:00Z | convo-sim workload: redwood-opt 95p=102ms, cloudA-managed 95p=185ms, infraZ self-host 95p=170ms. unit-cost-per-token: redwood=0.00045, cloudA=0.00078, infraZ=0.00060. CSV attached.
Evan Brooks: Nice. Maya, hero options: 
- "Ship fast, serve faster 100ms-level latency, predictable unit economics."
- "One API, any environment: cut complexity, control cost."
Samira Khan: For SDRs: keep 3 quick rebut lines vs cloudX: 1) predictable pricing and routing guarantees; 2) private deployment parity; 3) built-in graceful fallback to lower-cost variants.
Maya Chen: Love those. Also drafting a procurement FAQ: "How do we avoid vendor lock?" Suggest: "Pin model versions, route across capacity tiers, and export logs for audits."
Luis Romero: Legal check on cost claims please. We should avoid exact percentages unless bench doc appended. legal-bot: pinged.
legal-bot: FYI: avoid absolute "cheaper" claims. Approve phrasing that includes test conditions and links to raw bench CSV.
Evan Brooks: Slide ask: create 4 hero variants for A/B test in webinar registration page and 2 long-form deck variants (technical appendix vs business appendix).
Maya Chen: I'll do hero A/B + registration copy. Samira, can you write 6 SDR snippets (25-40 chars) and 3 longer scripts (1-2 sentences) for demo follow-ups?
Samira Khan: Yes. Samples coming in #marketing-playbooks in 30m.
Luis Romero: Also need a routing note for solution architects: "If latency SLOs are strict, route to dedicated pools; fallback to hosted for burst". Keep it one line.
bench-bot-2: addendum: bench runs used A100 vs cloudA's V100 family; see appendix for hardware parity note.
Evan Brooks: Good call. Add an appendix slide that lists GPU/quantization settings used. reduces buyer pushback.
Maya Chen: Quick copy test for registration CTA: 
Variant A: "See real-world latency & cost wins 1 live demo"
Variant B: "Compare inference economics in your stack 1 book a seat"
Luis Romero: Prefer B. More consultative.
Samira Khan: Draft SDR opener v1: "Hi — quick question: how predictable is your LLM inference bill? We help teams cut unit cost while keeping latencies tight." (shorten as needed).
legal-bot: Approved: include link to bench appendix and note "results may vary by workload".
Luis Romero: Final action list: Maya 1 hero + reg copy (due 2pm PT). Evan 1 deck variants + appendix (due 3pm PT). Samira 1 SDR snippets + follow-ups (due 2:30pm PT). Bench team 1 paste raw CSV in appendix (ASAP). Legal 1 final signoff before publish.
Evan Brooks: Copying this to project tracker. Adding estimated publish slot: Tue 9am PT if all green.
Maya Chen: Will post final hero options and pick top two for A/B test.
Samira Khan: Uploading SDR scripts now. Will post tracking tags for reply performance.
Luis Romero: Thanks team 1 tight but doable. I'll schedule a short rehearsal for the webinar narrative tomorrow at 9am PT.
